klifs_2026_07_22.name: KLIFS mechanism-supervision snapshot
klifs_2026_07_22.citation: Kanev et al., Nucleic Acids Research 2021, 49(D1):D562-D569, 'KLIFS: an overhaul after the first 5 years of supporting kinase research'
klifs_2026_07_22.licence: KLIFS FAQ explicitly states all KLIFS data are freely available/open for academia and industry; no SPDX/CC identifier is stated for the database snapshot, so attribution is mandatory and redistribution of derived PDB/MOE content requires a separate terms review
klifs_2026_07_22.role: external mechanism supervision for MIF-NK MNI-0; never an affinity-label source
klifs_2026_07_22.ifp_contract: 85 aligned kinase-pocket residues x 7 interaction types = 595 bits, plus DFG, alpha-C and subpocket annotations

contamination_audit.policy: exclude all Reinecke-development kinase families and every Reinecke connectivity/scaffold/near-neighbour from MNI training before any Reinecke mechanism score

klifs_2026_07_22.status: ACQUIRED_AND_HASHED; MNI-0 FAIL_STOP (target conditioning not identifiable); retained as reusable public mechanism infrastructure only
